import pytest
import my_memviz
from dataclasses import is_dataclass, fields


def test_graph_node_is_dataclass():
    assert is_dataclass(my_memviz.GraphNode)


def test_graph_node_required_fields():
    node = my_memviz.GraphNode(node_id=1, op_type="add", output_shape=[2, 3])
    assert node.node_id == 1
    assert node.op_type == "add"
    assert node.output_shape == [2, 3]


def test_graph_node_defaults():
    node = my_memviz.GraphNode(node_id=0, op_type="noop", output_shape=[])
    assert node.saved_tensors == []
    assert node.saved_memory_bytes == 0


def test_graph_node_saved_tensors_independent_per_instance():
    n1 = my_memviz.GraphNode(node_id=1, op_type="a", output_shape=[1])
    n2 = my_memviz.GraphNode(node_id=2, op_type="b", output_shape=[2])
    n1.saved_tensors.append({"name": "t"})
    assert n1.saved_tensors == [{"name": "t"}]
    assert n2.saved_tensors == []


def test_format_bytes_still_works():
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(0) == "0"
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(1000) == "1,000"
    assert my_memviz.format_bytes(1234567) == "1,234,567"
